"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

"Look, forget it. You wanted something?"

"Still on whether you've hurt someone."

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Gilberto Contreras is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Gilberto Contreras is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Gilberto kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Gilberto's gone." Carlos looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Gilberto." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Milo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Gilberto Contreras, 41 days. The mantle passes to Milo Piotrowski.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Milo Piotrowski, 57 — a pottery instructor. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Green Whisper.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Gilberto — and Gilberto is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Luigi, Carl, Carlos and 5 more speak for Milo — "Gilberto trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Milo before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
